316,730 surface samples; largest sampled overcut < 0.001 mm; declared center heights preserved.
Straight sections match the declared profiles within 0.004 mm NC rounding tolerance. Door outlines and tabs are unchanged.
Cutter radius remains visible at inside corners
Blue: cleared to 6 mm. Gray: retained stock.
The 12.7 mm flat cutter leaves a rounded inside corner;
we preserve the frame rather than overcutting it.
Sharp corners, arbitrary shallow slopes and shaped molding
Green sections and blue cutter footprints come from current NC. This is computational verification, not a physical cut test.
